title: The Dynastic Heirs' Regatta
logline: Twin heirs to a multi-system freight trust race across three star systems to claim their father's corporate succession, contracting armed escorts to secure contested fuel caches.

roles.description: The elder twin; reform-minded, seeking to dissolve the family monopoly and turn the shipping lanes over to independent crews.
The younger twin; ruthless, conservative, committed to preserving dynastic control over jump gate transit.
A heavy corporate cutter escorting the younger twin's racing yacht.
The massive family enterprise controlling long-haul cargo routes across four systems.
The coalition of small-ship pilots fighting against dynastic shipping tariffs.
The ancestral headquarters station in the home system where the race begins.
A deep-space fuel staging depot in a border system where racers must refuel.
The corporate assembly station in the destination system where the succession decree is registered.

public_situation: The twin heirs of {role:dynastic_freight_trust} begin an unsanctioned high-speed transit run across three systems to determine sole inheritance of the family enterprise.
private_truth: {role:traditionalist_heir} pre-purchased all emergency thorium reaction fuel at {role:waypoint_depot} through shell corporations to strand his twin in deep space.

beats.public_change: Regatta flags unfurl across {role:origin_station} as racing yachts power up twin fusion drives for the inter-system dash.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to deliver certified thorium fuel to his prototype yacht's reaction chambers before the starting signal sounds.
missions.private_fact: His twin emptied the family hangar's private fuel reserves thirty minutes before the race was announced.

beats.public_change: Both yachts jump into the border system with the traditionalist maintaining a narrow lead toward {role:waypoint_depot}.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to purchase spare coolant injection valves from the border station and deliver them to his yacht during the intermediate gate stop.
missions.private_fact: His yacht's engine safeties have been overridden to sustain twenty percent higher acceleration than designed.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to scan the waypoint fuel reserve logs and expose how his twin cornered the station's entire fuel inventory under shell accounts.
missions.private_fact: The station manager is his twin's godmother and took a five percent stock dividend to approve the monopoly.

beats.public_change: {role:rival_enforcer} takes position over the jump gate approach, targeting sublight thrusters on chasing vessels.

missions.reason: He needs the rival twin's armed escort disabled before its pulse cannons force his yacht out of the gate approach corridor.
missions.private_fact: The escort captain hails offering eighty thousand credits and an exclusive system freight franchise if the pilot disables the reformer's yacht.

beats.public_change: The yachts break out of hyperspace into {role:terminus_citadel} where company directors gather in formal robes.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to courier the documented fuel-monopoly evidence to the corporate succession tribunal before his twin registers the winning run.
missions.private_fact: He intends to sign an executive decree dissolving the dynastic monopoly within one hour of taking office.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot arrives at the corporate citadel as the succession assembly gathers to certify the winning heir.

options.label: Table the cornering proof and inaugurate the reformer twin to dissolve the trust
Broker a shared co-director succession forcing both twins to compromise
Suppress the evidence for a lifetime trade exemption from the traditionalist heir

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the cornering proof and disables the rival escort.
resolutions.summary: The reformer heir takes control of {role:dynastic_freight_trust}. He dissolves the family trade monopoly, opening key jump lanes to {role:independent_traders_league}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot flew escort across three systems to help a rebel heir smash his family's multi-system shipping monopoly.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a shared succession settlement between the twins.
resolutions.summary: A compromise divides the corporation. The twins become co-directors under strict municipal oversight, ending dynastic autocracy while preserving corporate stability.

resolutions.reached_by: The evidence is buried or the traditionalist heir registers the winning run.
resolutions.summary: The traditionalist heir registers the winning run unopposed. {role:dynastic_freight_trust} tightens its monopoly over regional trade corridors and jacks up tariffs.

loose_threads.detail: A waypoint fuel depot notice records an emergency reserve buyout registered to an offshore trust owned by the younger twin.
The rival escort cutter bears naval-grade armor plating registered to an unlisted private security holding firm.
The sealed succession packet contains a draft codicil indicating their father intended to dissolve the trust regardless of the race.

radio_hooks: Corporate media feeds broadcast real-time telemetry from dynastic succession regatta.
Independent traders association condemns high-speed racing through commercial freight lanes.
Transit authorities report severe fuel rationing at border waypoint depots.

voice_direction.reformer_heir: Intense, articulate, and driven. Speaks with aristocratic polish but peppers his speech with egalitarian political theory and hatred of monopolies.
voice_direction.traditionalist_heir: Arrogant, dismissive, and icy. Treats multi-system trade networks like private family property and views independent pilots as trespassers.
